cds.title: Indiana University Indianapolis Common Data Set 2025-2026 (IU Institutional Analytics CDS app, campus IU-Indianapolis, year 2025, section C)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 first-time first-year, IU Indianapolis campus): 16,460 applied, 12,846 admitted (78%). International: 625 applied, 350 admitted (56%), 19 enrolled, so international applicants are admitted far less often than domestic ones. No early decision; no waitlist. 28.5% (918) of enrolled students sent SAT scores and 2.4% (78) sent ACT scores. IU Indianapolis was created in 2024 when IUPUI was split; every figure here is from the IU Indianapolis Fall 2025 Common Data Set, and no IUPUI-era figure is included. The admission-factor checkboxes could not be read reliably from the text, so they are left out. Undergraduate enrollment and the number of international undergraduates come from the 'Total Undergraduates' figures (14,834; nonresident 273 including non-degree students).

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set: IU Indianapolis has a test-optional admission policy; the applicant decides at application whether SAT or ACT scores are considered.

cost.notes: First-year costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set: in-state tuition $9,518, out-of-state $33,983 (international students pay the out-of-state rate), required fees $1,244, on-campus food and housing $13,656, books $1,290. The international office estimates $36,110 tuition and fees (including the $331/year international services fee) and $56,258 total for 9 months. 117 nonresident undergraduates received aid from the college itself, averaging $12,369. The need-based and non-need-based boxes in the Common Data Set are ambiguous in the text, so need-based aid for international students is not shown
